scenarios.name: Import settings with edits staged on two ribbon targets

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows All Commands and initially empty Part Tools and Part Manage targets
a settings file contains 2D Sketches on Part Tools and no custom entries for Part Manage
3D Annotations is staged on Part Tools
2D Sketches is staged on Part Manage
Part Manage is the selected target
the user imports the settings file
the Part Manage target list is empty
Part Manage shows a pending-change marker
the user selects the Part Tools target
the target contains 2D Sketches with Large and Text unchecked
3D Annotations is available in the source list
Part Tools shows a pending-change marker
the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog
